title: Project pin list, version 1
description: Lockfile recording what each embedded element copy came from (part D §5). The client verifies a pinned element against the hash HERE, never against a hash a channel or server supplies (S3). Departure from the part D example: a pin names the library (namespace), not a feed URL. The client maps a namespace to the sources it has configured; a pin that named a URL would be a field naming a resource to fetch (S1) and would let a project file pick its own source (S5). SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0.

policy.description: notify: offer updates for review (default). patch: patch-level updates may be applied without asking. hold: no update notices.

overrides.description: Local changes reapplied after an update: labels, texts, metadata. Never geometry or ports — that is a fork.

derived_from.description: For state 'forked': <uuid>@<version> of the element forked from, which makes a later three-way merge possible.

detached.description: For state 'detached': an explicit, recorded action. The embedded copy stays and the UUID is kept, so reattaching is possible.

catalogueRevision.description: Revision of the translation catalogues the embedded names came from, so a later language update knows what it compares against.
